questions.q: Why could Joseph's brethren not recognize him?
choices: He was grown, and clothed in the customs and dress of Egypt
He was hidden behind a curtain
questions.explain: He shaved, changed his raiment, and spoke by an interpreter.

questions.q: Who did Joseph say sent him into Egypt?
questions.explain: It was not you that sent me hither, but God.

questions.q: What law did Joseph keep with his brethren?
questions.explain: His own brothers sold him into slavery, and he forgave them.

questions.q: What does 'better is the end of a thing than the beginning thereof' teach from Joseph's life?
choices: Sold and imprisoned at the beginning, governor of Egypt at the end
The end of the world is near
questions.explain: Be patient in spirit; there is no other way into the kingdom but through tribulation.
